forecast_range.rationale: Known operating alternatives distinguish reported common profit 41.895255 trillion from the 33.019724 trillion adverse-incidence case. This is not a full bound; developer cash recognition and timing materially change forecast precision.

sensitivity.rationale: Actual transaction-income operands and the sign-changing cash series substantiate the economic sensitivity. No point is inferred from a mechanical valuation grid or from missing RNAV documents.

dependencies.rationale: Handover/collection timing, recurrence of transfers and common tax/NCI incidence remain named economic dependencies. The exact reviewed NCI/closing-column overlay resolves one source error without resolving project cash attribution or converting accounting book capital to RNAV.

assessment.rationale: Four-year consolidated CFO swings from 31.520190 trillion to 1.516891 trillion, -22.399550 trillion and 41.189141 trillion VND; cumulative reported cash realization is only about 36.73% of group NPAT. Separately reviewed FY2025 termination income of 5.157729 trillion and investment-transfer income of 3.717802 trillion materially affect the common-earnings bridge. These observed cash-timing and transaction-income channels support high forward value-estimation uncertainty, even though the FY2025 profit/cash observations and corrected NCI are available.
disconfirmingEvidence: FY2025 reported revenue, group profit and CFO are positive; the final year cash recovery is real evidence against treating the prior negative CFO as a permanent loss.

Investment transfers can recur as part of property development. Fully excluding both named income items is a conservative conditional case, not proven recurring earnings, and a cash-timing gap is not itself an impairment or accounting misstatement.

evidence.rationale: Known operating alternatives distinguish reported common profit 41.895255 trillion from the 33.019724 trillion adverse-incidence case. This is not a full bound; developer cash recognition and timing materially change forecast precision.
Actual transaction-income operands and the sign-changing cash series substantiate the economic sensitivity. No point is inferred from a mechanical valuation grid or from missing RNAV documents.

Handover/collection timing, recurrence of transfers and common tax/NCI incidence remain named economic dependencies. The exact reviewed NCI/closing-column overlay resolves one source error without resolving project cash attribution or converting accounting book capital to RNAV.

challenge.rationale: Challenged whether improved FY2025 cash and a corrected NCI justify manageable uncertainty. They qualify those reported facts, but do not erase the observed multi-year cash timing or the source-sized transfer/termination-income dependency. Accepted high uncertainty for forecast precision only, without rating project impairment, governance or relative valuation.
